claims: Jamie Dixon is the head coach of the TCU men's basketball team.
Jamie Dixon has held the position of head coach of the TCU men's basketball team since March 2016.
Jamie Dixon is a former TCU player.
Jamie Dixon is a 2007 Hall of Fame inductee.
Jamie Dixon returned to TCU on March 22, 2016.
Jamie Dixon was head coach at the University of Pittsburgh for 13 seasons.
Jamie Dixon was the 2009 USA Basketball National Coach of the Year.
Jamie Dixon is a two-time gold medalist.
Jamie Dixon agreed to a contract extension in 2024 running through the 2029-30 season.
Jamie Dixon's reported pay exceeds $4.1 million annually.
Tony Benford is Associate Head Coach supporting Jamie Dixon at TCU men's basketball.
Duane Broussard is an assistant supporting Jamie Dixon at TCU men's basketball.
Jamie McNeilly is an assistant supporting Jamie Dixon at TCU men's basketball.
A 59-second video from Big 12 Conference on YouTube dated Jan 9, 2026 features an interview with TCU Head Men's Basketball Coach Jamie Dixon.
Mark Campbell is the head coach of the TCU women's basketball team.
Mark Campbell was hired on March 21, 2023.
Mark Campbell signed a contract extension in March 2025 to stay through 2030
